did.abstract: Begun in 1972, the Gallatin School of Individualized Study provides a liberal arts education for undergraduate and graduate students. The curriculum includes an array of seminar-style, interdisciplinary courses and flexible degree requirements. Individualized programs of study, or concentrations, are organized around a theme, problem, activity, period of history, area of the world, or central idea. The Records of the Office of Academic Affairs, Gallatin School of Individualized Study (dated 1984-2020) consists of course bulletins, course lists, and instructor handbooks.
did.physloc: Materials are stored offsite and advance notice is required for use. Please request materials at least two business days prior to your research visit to coordinate access.

userestrict.p: Any rights (including copyright and related rights to publicity and privacy) held by the Gallatin School of Individualized Study are maintained by New York University.
